questions.q_en: In a linear race of 900 m, A beats B by 80 m or 8 seconds. What is the difference between A and B speeds (in m/s)?
questions.solution_en:
When A covers 900 m B covers 820 m

Also, B covers 80 m in 8 seconds

So, the speed of B = 80/8 = 10 m/sec

Time taken by B to cover 820 m = 820/ 10 = 82 seconds

Speed of A = 900/82 = 450/41 m/s

Hence, the difference between the speed of A and B = 450/41 - 10

= (450 - 410)/41

= 40/41 m/sec

questions.q_en: Two candidates P and Q contested in an election. 20% of the total votes are invalid. P got 65% of the total valid votes and won by 600 votes. Find the number of invalid votes.
questions.solution_en:
Percentage of valid votes Q got = 35%

Given,

65% - 35% = 600

30% = 600

100% = 2000

Total valid votes = 2000

Percentage of invalid votes = 20%

Therefore,

Number of invalid votes = 2000 * 20/80 = 500

questions.q_en: The side of a rhombus is 2√7 cm and length of one diagonal is 4√3 cm. The area of the rhombus will be:
questions.solution_en:
Side of rhombus = 2√7 cm

Half-length of one diagonal = 2√3 cm

Half-length of second diagonal = √ [(2√7)2 - (2√3)2]

= √ (28 - 12) = 4 cm

Length of second diagonal = 8 cm

Area of rhombus = (1/2) * product of diagonals

= (1/2) * (4√3) * 8 = 16√3 sq. cm

questions.q_en: A natural number n divides 732 and leaves 12 as a remainder. How many values of n are possible?
questions.solution_en:
732 = n * q + 12

n * q = 720

Factors of 720 = 24 * 32*5

Total number of factors = (4 + 1)(2 + 1)(1 + 1) = 30

Factors less than or equal to 12 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12 = total 10

So, possible values of n = 30 - 10 = 20

questions.q_en: A boat can cover 3K km in upstream in 9 hours. If the ratio of the speed of the boat in still water and speed of the stream is 7: 2, then in how much time it will cover K km in downstream?
questions.solution_en:
Let speed of the boat in still water and speed of the stream are 7x km/h and 2x km/h

Upstream speed = 3K/9 = K/3

=> K/3 = 7x - 2x

=> K = 5x * 3 = 15x

So, required time = 15x/(7x + 2x) = 15/9 = 1(2/3) hours

questions.q_en: Two trains start from stations A and B, 300 km apart, and travel towards each other at 60 km/h and 90 km/h. They cross and continue to the opposite stations. What is the difference in their arrival times at the opposite ends?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken to meet = 300/(60+90) = 2 h

First train covers (60 X 2 =) 120 km to meeting.

Remaining distance for first train to cover = 300−120 = 180 km

=> time taken = 180/60 = 3 h

=> total time taken = 5 h

Second train covers (90 X 2 =) 180 km to meeting.

Remaining distance for second train to cover = 300−180 = 120 km

=> time taken = 120/90 = 1.333 h = 1 h 20 min

=> total time taken = 3 h 20 min

Required difference = 5 h − 3 h 20 min = 1 h 40 min

questions.q_en: A boy takes 9 hours to swim 11.25 km downstream and 9 hours to swim 9 km upstream. What is the flow of stream?
questions.solution_en:
Downstream speed (D) = 11.25/9 = 1.25 km/hr

Upstream speed (U) = 9/9 = 1 km/hr

Flow of stream = (1/2) * (D - U)

= (1/2) * (1.25 - 1)

= (1/2) * 0.25 = 0.125 km/hr

In a two-digit number, 3 times the tens digit is equal to the 4 times the unit digit. If difference between original number and number obtained after reversing its digits is 9, then find the sum of digits.
questions.solution_en:
Since, 3 times the tens digit is equal to the 4 times the unit digit which means ratio of tens digit to unit digit of the number = 4: 3.

Let tens digit and unit digit of the two-digits number is '4x' and '3x' respectively.

Original number = 4x * 10 + 3x = 43x

Number obtained after reversing the digits = 3x * 10 + 4x = 34x

According to the question:

43x - 34x = 9

9x = 9

x = 1

Sum of digits = 4x + 3x

= 7x

= 7 * 1 = 7

questions.q_en: In a garden, there are 6 daisy plants the first year. Each year, a gardener adds 3 new daisy plants. He has 26 jasmine plants the first year and loses 2 each year. When will the number of daisy plants equal to the number of jasmine plants after the first year?
questions.solution_en:
Let the number of years after the first year be n .

Number of daisy plants after n years = 6 + 3n

Number of jasmine plants after n years = 26 - 2n

We need to find when the number of daisy plants equals the number of jasmine plants:

6 + 3n = 26 - 2n

=> 6 + 3n = 26 - 2n

=> 3n + 2n = 26 - 6

=> 5n = 20

=> n = 4

questions.q_en: In triangle ABC, the length of side BC is 2 cm less than twice the length of side AB. The length of side AC exceeds the length of side AB by 10 cm. The perimeter of the triangle is 40 cm. Determine the length (in cm) of the smallest side of the triangle.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length of side AB = x cm

Then, length of side BC = 2x - 2 cm

And, length of side AC = x + 10 cm

Perimeter of triangle ABC = AB + BC + AC

Given perimeter = 40 cm

So, x + (2x - 2) + (x + 10) = 40

=> x + 2x - 2 + x + 10 = 40

=> 4x + 8 = 40

=> 4x = 40 - 8

=> 4x = 32

=> x = 8

Therefore, the length of the smallest side (AB) = 8 cm
